bookmaker.text: All the runners, all the prices. Each way if you're nervous, on the nose if you're not.

clerk.text: The Novice Stakes, run once a day. Bring one of your own creatures and we'll find it a number cloth.

then.text: The going's soft today, proper soft. Back anything with webbed feet and a positive attitude.
Good to firm out there. The quick ones'll fly. The slow ones'll get a nice tan.

else.text: Here's a tip for nothing: read the form, check the going, then back the one with the daftest name. Same as everyone else.

tipster.text: And never chase your losses, they're faster than you.
